Mia L: quick heads-up — int8 bringup for reranker-v3 finished.
Mia L: overall NDCG ~0.78 (baseline 0.80), MRR almost unchanged.
Tomás R: can you paste slice breakdown? which cohorts dropped?
Mia L: faq-domain (short Q/A) shows NDCG 0.60 -> 0.48, MRR 0.66 -> 0.64
Eval-Bot: run 1751112222: rerank-v3-int8 | ndcg@10=0.480 | mrr@10=0.640 | samples=12.3k
Evan C: huge ndcg slip for FAQ but mrr small — suggests top-rank rearrangement, maybe tie-handling or dedup.
Julia (eng-ml): any difference in candidate preprocessing vs baseline? truncation/html stripping?
Mia L: baseline had html-unescape + snippet-trim at 256 chars; int8 path used serve-side truncation at 192 (bug)
Tomás R: that explains short answer context removed.
Evan C: also check candidate-dedupe: we recently enabled hash-dedupe upstream — could collapse near-duplicates and change ordering.
Mia L: quick diff: baseline dedupe=false, int8 dedupe=true. oops.
Tomás R: run a quick ablation: int8 + dedupe=false + trunc=256
Mia L: running now:
Mia L: ```
./eval_harness --model rerank-v3-int8 --cohort faq --dedupe false --trunc 256 --out tmp/175111
``` 
Eval-Bot: ablation queued (job 1751112230)
Eval-Bot: job 1751112230 finished | ndcg@10=0.589 | mrr@10=0.648 | samples=12.3k
Mia L: ablation recovers most NDCG (0.48 -> 0.589). so root cause is trunc+dedupe combo.
Evan C: nice catch. plan: revert dedupe in bringup, patch truncation to use shared preprocess config.
Julia (eng-ml): can we add a tiny unit-test in bringup harness to assert per-cohort preprocess parity vs baseline? something like compare preprocessing hashes on sample set.
Tomás R: +1 and add a note to the onboarding checklist: 'confirm candidate preprocessing flags (trunc, strip_html, dedupe) match baseline'
Mia L: will push fix and re-run full eval tomorrow morning.
Evan C: FYI add to release notes: int8-v3 had preprocessing deviation causing faq NDCG regression; no model quality change.
Mia L: thanks all :thumbsup:
